nodes.description: Public mapping balanceOf(address=>uint) holding token balances, mutated without SafeMath in transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping allowance(owner=>spender=>uint) storing spending approvals, decremented unchecked in transferFrom.
Private owner address set to msg.sender in constructor, gates privileged functions.
Whitelisted trade address that bypasses the sale condition check.
Mapping(address=>bool) granting whitelisted accounts the right to transfer.
Mapping(address=>uint256) counting transfers per sender, compared against _saleNum.
Minimum transfer amount enforced by condition().
Maximum transfer amount enforced by condition().
Per-address transfer count limit set by init().
Public total supply, set in constructor with unsafe multiplication.
Public token name string.
Public token symbol string.
Public constant decimals = 18, used in scale computations in init() and constructor.
Hardcoded constant UNI router address 0x7a25...488D whitelisted in ensure().
payable transfer(address,uint) that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
internal view gate that whitelists owner, UNI, pair address and tradeAddress, otherwise calls condition().
payable transferFrom(address,address,uint) updating allowance and balances with unchecked arithmetic and calling ensure().
payable approve(address,uint) writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
internal view enforcing _saleNum, _onSaleNum, _minSale and _maxSale transfer constraints.
payable delegate(address,bytes) performing an arbitrary delegatecall after an owner-only check.
owner-gated init() configuring _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum.
owner-gated batchSend() performing unchecked multiplication for total and an unbounded loop of balance credits.
owner-gated setTradeAddress() updating the whitelisted trade address.
internal pure pairFor() computing the Uniswap pair address via CREATE2 hashing.
payable constructor minting totalSupply with an unchecked multiplication and granting infinite UNI allowance.
SafeERC20 private helper executing an arbitrary low-level token call after an isContract check.
msg.sender used for authorization checks, allowance accounting and owner assignment.
a.delegatecall(b) inside delegate() executes attacker-supplied bytecode in the token's storage context.
address(token).call(data) in callOptionalReturn performs an unchecked external low-level call.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value and allowance decrement performed without SafeMath.
balanceOf[_to] += _value performed without overflow protection.
uint total = _value * _tos.length can overflow, understating the required balance.
totalSupply = _supply*(10**uint256(decimals)) multiplies without overflow checks.
